definition.summary: Scales its input by a function of a condition vector: `input ⊙ (1 + out · act(in · condition))`.
definition.description: The condition — one vector of `condition_width`, delivered on `condition` in another domain than `input`'s (an `align` transform: a per-sequence embedding scales every element of a token stream) — is projected by `in` to `rank`, passed through `activation`, projected back by `out` to `width`, and one plus the result multiplies `input` element by element. Nothing is added to a residual and nothing is normalised: this is the adaptive scale Voxtral Realtime applies to the feed-forward's normed input in every decoder layer, its condition the time embedding of the transcription delay. The elements `condition` delivers are held by `condition_cache`, an `append` state indexed by that port and shared `by_source`: an invocation delivering nothing on the port — every decode step — evaluates the occurrence through the held condition (§7), and a session forked after the condition arrived shares it whole. Compare `conditioning.multiplicative`, which gates the input, multiplies by a per-layer condition, projects back and normalises what the layer adds to its residual: another mechanism, hence another contract.

rank.description: Rank of the condition path: `in` projects the condition to `rank`, `out` projects it back to `width`.

activation.description: Non-linearity between the two projections; changes no tensor.

input.description: The activation to scale: one vector of `width` per element of its domain.

condition.note: the condition comes from ANOTHER domain, the one the edge into this port carries (an `align` transform); its elements are held by `condition_cache`
condition.description: The condition vector, in the domain of the edge that feeds this port: one per sequence for a time embedding.

output.description: `input ⊙ (1 + out · act(in · condition))`, in the domain of `input`.

out.description: Projection of the activated rank vector to `width`: the scale, less one.

append.description: Hold the condition vectors this invocation delivers.

read.description: Read the held condition when the port delivers nothing.

rules.description: Indexed by the stream of `condition`: grown along it, frozen once it is complete — after one element, for a per-sequence embedding — and shared whole by sessions whose condition is the same.

condition_cache.description: The elements the condition port delivered, held in full: a decode step delivers nothing on the port and is evaluated through them (§7).

logical_cost.description: Per element the primitive multiplies and adds `width` channels; the two projections the inventory counts per element run once per sequence, moved to the entry below.
The condition path — `in`, the activation, `out` — once per condition vector, one per sequence.

partitions.description: Per feature: a shard scales the features it holds, computing the rank-`rank` condition path whole (`in` replicated, `out` sliced by rows).

domain_transforms.description: The condition is read across domains: one vector per sequence scales every element of the input's stream, and the output stays in the input's domain.

definition.note: Adaptive scale from a condition vector through a rank bottleneck; the condition is held by a state so that later invocations need not redeliver it.
